subject: Observability activation: dashboards, tracing hooks & escalation routing
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cascadiahealth.org>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Santos <maria.santos@cascadiahealth.org>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Observability activation: dashboards, tracing hooks & escalation routing

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff earlier this week. We want to lock down the runbook and alert routing before our internal go/no-go on March 1. Specifically we need: 

- A short list of dashboards (latency by route, token-cost per model, request-origin heatmap) that we can point our execs to.
- Tracing integration guidance for our Java-based gateway (sampling, span naming conventions, and trace propagation headers).
- A proposed escalation matrix for paged incidents vs. informational alerts (who gets paged, on-call rotations).

I've attached our internal ops org chart and a rough list of current alert noise we hope to reduce. Can your team propose a 2-week implementation sprint plan with clear owners and a 3-step rollback for any noisy alerts?

Best,
Alex

Attachments: cascadia_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx), current-alerts-export.csv (csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cascadiahealth.org>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability activation: dashboards, tracing hooks & escalation routing

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We can absolutely deliver a concise activation corridor that covers dashboards, tracing, and escalation routing. Quick outline below; I'll schedule a follow-up to confirm owners.

High-level plan (proposal):
1) Week 1 (Feb 21-25): Instrumentation & tracing hooks
   - Laura to own sample configuration and span naming guide for the gateway.
   - Ben to validate sampling & ingestion into tracing back-end; set default 5% sampling for non-prod, 25% for prod heat-maps (tunable).
2) Week 2 (Feb 28-Mar 4): Dashboards + Alert tuning
   - Neha to build three executive dashboards and a runbook landing dashboard for SRE.
   - Noise reduction pass: identify top-10 noisy alerts, add conditional suppression, and add a ramp/verification window.
3) Rollback & Escalation
   - Draft esc matrix and 3-step rollback: mute -> reduce sensitivity -> revert to previous rule. Pager escalation thresholds will be tied to service-error-rate and request-latency SLO breaches.

I'll attach a first-pass implementation checklist and escalation matrix. Can you confirm owners for on-call and whether your infra team will allow us access to the tracing endpoint? If procurement needs an estimated statement of work and timeline we can include that in the doc.

Thanks — Priya

Attachments: cascadia_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, escalation_matrix_draft.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Observability activation: dashboards, tracing hooks & escalation routing

Priya —

Looping you and the infra folks for scoping. Quick notes after review of Cascadia's checklist:
- They are on AWS EKS with an Envoy-based ingress; we'll use header-based trace propagation (x-b3 or traceparent depending on their sidecar). Laura, can you provide a small code sample for the Java gateway?
- They have an existing long-tail alert that fires on 5xx spikes caused by a partner timeout — we should propose an alert enrichment (add request.source and partner.id) rather than suppression.
- Cascadia needs a 1-page runbook for their application owners and a deeper SRE runbook. I'll own the 1-page and hand off the SRE runbook to Ben.

Neha

>
> —Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cascadiahealth.org>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability activation: dashboards, tracing hooks & escalation routing

Alex / team —

Sharing a compact tracing snippet and naming conventions below (will drop in Drive as well).

Tracing guidance (Java/Envoy):
- Instrument incoming requests with span name: service.gateway.request — include attributes: http.method, route.path, client.id, request.size.
- Propagation: prefer W3C traceparent; fallback to B3 for older libs.
- Sampling: user-initiated flows (login/payment) -> 100% for first 1 minute when triaging post-launch; otherwise default per Priya's plan.
- Example header usage: Traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01

I'll push code snippets to the shared Drive link and mock a small Envoy filter that maps request headers into span attributes.

Laura

Attachments: dashboards-wiring.png

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Next steps and action owners below:

- Ben: ingest tracing samples and validate end-to-end visibility by Feb 24.

If procurement needs an SOW for approvals, contracts@cascadiahealth.org, please reply with the preferred template and we'll adapt.

Appreciate the fast turn.

—Priya
